note: THREAD_SCALING_PLAN.md: HPRC2 human_short and human_ont_modern 1 Gbase sets, ms2 min, psi, phi and dual and ropebwt3 -l1 at 1 to 64 threads on one AWS i4i.metal per job, after the 64-thread SMT check

numa.physcpubind: the first T physical cores, node 0 first; T = 64 on both hardware threads of the first 32 cores (binding smt)

protocol.truth_check: run 1 of every cell, whole output
protocol.order: cells in an order shuffled from the manifest seed and the job id; each cell runs its three runs back to back, so a done cell is final (D10)

time_basis.ms2: phase timer: query = total_s (read, parse, query, format, write), load = index_load_s + ftab_s
time_basis.ropebwt3: log stamps: load = last loaded stamp, query = last processed stamp minus load
time_basis.legacy: whole-process wall of the full run minus the one-read run, both cold

protocol.cross_thread_check: every run of every cell records its output sha256, which must be the same at every thread count of a tool, mode and read set (collect.py)
